lines.en: label christmastwo9:
scene imaniandgirls1
And by “everyone else” I mean Imani, Makoto, and Nodoka- who have closed themselves off in the bedroom and are now casually drinking and discussing-
lines.zh: 我说的“其他各位”，指的是 Imani、Makoto 和 Nodoka——她们把自己关在卧室里，正悠闲地喝着酒，讨论着——

lines.en: : I’m telling you guys, genomics is the way of the future!
lines.zh: : 我跟你们说，基因组学才是未来！

lines.en: Ahh, yes. They are discussing that.
lines.zh: 啊，对。她们在讨论这个。

lines.en: : Hey, everyone. I’m here now, which means we can talk about interesting things.
lines.zh: : 大家好啊。我来了，这意味着我们可以聊点有趣的东西了。

lines.en: : You really think so, Miss Imai? You’re not worried about the prospects of things like...gene editing? Because I think the stigma surrounding that is rather well-deserved.
lines.zh: : 你真这么觉得吗，Imai 小姐？你不担心比如……基因编辑之类的前景吗？因为我觉得围绕它的污名完全是它应得的。

lines.en: scene imaniandgirls2
: Ugh! Can you stop it with the “Miss Imai” stuff? I told you to call me Imani. Miss Imai is my cat.
lines.zh: : 呃！你能别再“Imai 小姐”了吗？我都说了叫我 Imani。Imai 小姐是我的猫。

lines.en: : You have a cat?
lines.zh: : 你养猫？

lines.en: scene imaniandgirls3
: Yeah. Miss Imai. I literally just told you that. Are you drunk already?
lines.zh: : 对。Imai 小姐。我刚刚才说过啊。你已经喝醉了吗？

lines.en: : If I was drunk, I’d be in your lap.
lines.zh: : 我要是醉了，这会儿就坐你腿上了。

lines.en: : Ahem.
lines.zh: : Ahem.

lines.en: scene imaniandgirls4
: Or yours.
lines.zh: : 或者坐你的腿上。

lines.en: : Ayyy! Look who it is! I was starting to think I’d have to chaperone this party by myself!
lines.zh: : 哟！看看这是谁！我还以为今晚得我一个人来监督这场派对呢！

lines.en: : Well you seem to be doing a great job judging by the alcohol in my students’ hands.
lines.zh: : 从你塞到我学生手里的酒来看，你干得相当不错嘛。

lines.en: : Interesting. You’ve never cared about that before, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 有意思。你以前可从不在乎这个，老师。

lines.en: : Could it be that you’re simply trying to impress our new, and quite beautiful student teacher?
lines.zh: : 会不会只是因为你想在我们这位新来的、而且相当漂亮的实习老师面前表现一下？

lines.en: scene imaniandgirls5
: Oh gosh! Is that true?! But...no! We shouldn’t!
lines.zh: : 天哪！是真的吗？！但是……不行！我们不能！

lines.en: : You’re my senpai! It wouldn’t be right!
lines.zh: : 你是我的前辈！那不合适！

lines.en: : I’m not trying to impress anyone. In fact, I couldn’t care less what you girls drink. I just figured Imani was going to be the responsible one out of the two of us- not just another me.
lines.zh: : 我才没想讨好谁。事实上，你们喝什么我一点都不在乎。我只是以为 Imani 会是我们俩之中那个靠谱的人——而不是又一个我。

lines.en: scene imaniandgirls6
: You girls good?
lines.zh: : 你们还好吗？

lines.en: : I’m fine.
lines.zh: : 我没事。

lines.en: : Same here.
lines.zh: : 我也一样。

lines.en: scene imaniandgirls7
: They say they’re good.
lines.zh: : 她们说她们没事。

lines.en: : How did this even happen? I thought Makoto was basically going to be at war with you for the rest of forever.
lines.zh: : 这到底是怎么发生的？我还以为 Makoto 会和你打一辈子的仗呢。

lines.en: scene imaniandgirls8
: Actually, I’m really starting to come around to Miss Imai! It turns out that she isn’t just an impostor after all! She’s actually really smart!
lines.zh: : 其实我现在真的开始接受 Imai 小姐了！事实证明她根本不是什么冒牌货！她其实超聪明的！

lines.en: : Mwahaha yes, bow to the true teacher of...whatever class we are in!
lines.zh: : 哇哈哈哈，对，向真正的老师——不管我们是哪个班的——下跪吧！

lines.en: : Well, as long as you don’t start taking a cut of my salary, I’m fine with whatever.
lines.zh: : 行，只要你不开始从我的工资里抽成，怎么样都行。

lines.en: scene imaniandgirls9

: You should honestly be happy you’re still getting paid at all, Sensei. I’m beginning to think the reason I didn’t know about Miss Imai coming in is that even {i}my{/i} reputation is starting to diminish because of you.
lines.zh: : 说实话，老师你还能拿到工资就该偷着乐了。我开始怀疑，我没听说 Imai 小姐要来，是不是因为连{i}我的{/i}名声都被你拖累了。

lines.en: : What? Why?
lines.zh: : 什么？为什么？

lines.en: : Obviously because I spend all of my time doing your dirty work and, for some strange reason, have not filed a single formal complaint about it.
lines.zh: : 显然是因为我所有的时间都在替你干脏活，而且出于某种奇怪的理由，一次正式的投诉都没提交过。

lines.en: : Which, you know, I really should have on account of all of those times you’ve been utterly horrible to me.
lines.zh: : 你知道的，考虑到你对我那么多次恶劣至极，我真该投诉的。

lines.en: : Well thanks, Makoto. I’ll make it up to you soon. Really.
lines.zh: : 谢了，Makoto。我很快会补偿你的。真的。

lines.en: scene imaniandgirls10
: Oh! Um...oh.
: Do you not want me to?
lines.zh: : 你不想让我补偿？

lines.en: : No, of course I do. I just thought you were being serious for a second when you’d obviously never go out of your way for-
lines.zh: : 不，我当然想。我只是有一瞬间以为你是认真的，毕竟你明显从来不会特意为了我……

lines.en: : I’m serious. You just wait.
lines.zh: : 我是认真的。你就等着吧。

lines.en: There’s a chance I’m only thinking this due to an infection brought on by the sensation of Christmas cheer oozing into every one of my pores, but...I really should do something nice for Makoto.
lines.zh: 我之所以会这么想，有可能是因为圣诞的喜悦渗进了我每一个毛孔、引发了某种感染，不过……我真的该为 Makoto 做点好事。

lines.en: It’s one thing to constantly burden her by turning her into my “at-school Ami” in the fact that she does {i}everything{/i} for me-
lines.zh: 一直把她变成我的“在校版 Ami”、让她替我做{i}所有的事{/i}，这本身就已经够让她受累的了——

lines.en: But if doing all of that is actually making her feel bad...I should at least try {i}something.{/i}
lines.zh: 但如果做这些事真的让她心里不好受……我至少该{i}试一试{/i}。

lines.en: : So, Imani, do you truly intend to stay with our class for better or for worse? Or is this a temporary thing for you before getting a class of your own?
lines.zh: : 那么，Imani，你是真的打算不管好坏都留在我们班？还是说这只是暂时的，之后你会去带自己的班？

lines.en: scene imaniandgirls11
: Depends on how much this guy likes me, I guess.
lines.zh: : 大概取决于这家伙有多喜欢我吧。

lines.en: : I don’t think there are any openings for full-on teachers right now. Especially with that other school still way, way, way underground.
lines.zh: : 我觉得现在应该没有正式教师的空缺。尤其是另一所学校还深深深地埋在地下呢。

lines.en: : I’m kinda just doing what I’m told since I can’t really afford to be fucking around currently.
lines.zh: : 我现在也算是听命行事，毕竟我真的没本钱瞎混。

lines.en: : What do you mean you can’t afford it? What is the school paying you, exactly?
lines.zh: : 你说没本钱是什么意思？学校到底给你开多少？

lines.en: : Not much, dude. I don’t even have a place to stay right now.
lines.zh: : 没多少，老兄。我现在连个住的地方都没有。

lines.en: scene imaniandgirls12
: What do you mean you don’t have a place to stay? Where have you been sleeping?
lines.zh: : 什么叫没有住的地方？你一直睡哪儿？

lines.en: : Where has the {i}cat{/i} been sleeping?
lines.zh: : {i}猫{/i}又睡哪儿？

lines.en: : I’ve got a few months left of a spa membership thing, so I’ve kinda just been crashing over there every night.
lines.zh: : 我那个水疗会员还剩几个月，所以我基本就每晚在那儿凑合。

lines.en: : You can probably stay with me if you’d like. And this isn’t me just being predatorial. Though, I certainly {i}can{/i} be if that’s what you want.
lines.zh: : 你愿意的话可以跟我住。我这可不全是在打你的主意。不过，如果你想要的话，我当然也{i}可以是{/i}。

lines.en: : It’s fine. Like I said, I’ve got a couple months left until it {i}really{/i} becomes a problem.
lines.zh: : 没事。就像我说的，还有几个月才{i}真的{/i}成问题。

lines.en: : And I’m also pretty sure I remember the school telling me something about maybe opening up another floor in the dorm for me to stay in, so I’m just hoping that’s all set up by then.
lines.zh: : 而且我好像记得学校跟我说过，可能会在宿舍再开一层给我住，所以我就指望到那时候能弄好。

lines.en: : Which dorm? Our dorm? Or the one down the road from ours?
lines.zh: : 哪个宿舍？我们的宿舍？还是离我们不远的那栋？

lines.en: : Pretty sure it’s yours. Would be kinda weird if it wasn't.
lines.zh: : 应该是你们的。要不是就太奇怪了。

lines.en: : What the hell? Why don’t I get a room at that dorm? That would save me so much walking.
lines.zh: : 搞什么鬼？为什么我在那栋宿舍没有房间？那能省我多少走路的时间啊。

lines.en: scene imaniandgirls13
: Probably because you’d never leave.
lines.zh: : 大概是因为你住进去就再也不走了。

lines.en: : I extend the same invite I gave to Imani to you, Sensei. Though, I think Otoha would be a bit more hesitant to sleep in the same room as you on account of our {i}relationship.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我对老师发出和 Imani 一样的邀请。不过考虑到我们的{i}关系{/i}，我想 Otoha 会对和你睡一间房这件事更犹豫一些。

lines.en: : This something I’m gonna have to report to the higher-ups?
lines.zh: : 这事我是不是得向上级汇报？

lines.en: : Is that something you actually {i}would{/i} report to the higher ups?
lines.zh: : 你真的{i}会{/i}向上级汇报这种事吗？

lines.en: scene imaniandgirls14
: Yo. Do you consent?
lines.zh: : 哟。你同意吗？

lines.en: : I consent to anything and everything. Let that fact be known.
lines.zh: : 我同意任何事、一切事。请把这个事实记录在案。

lines.en: scene imaniandgirls15
: Nah, you good. I won’t say anything.
lines.zh: : 没事，你放心。我什么都不会说。

lines.en: : There wouldn’t be anything to say either way since Nodoka and I don’t have any sort of relationship.
lines.zh: : 反正也没什么可说的，因为 Nodoka 和我之间没有任何那种关系。

lines.en: : Your class is fucking weird, man. I know you’re a hot dude and stuff, but I didn’t really expect a whole tribe of girls fighting some kinda battle royale for your affection.
lines.zh: : 你们班真是他妈的怪，老兄。我知道你是个帅哥什么的，但我真没想到会有整整一族女生为了你的宠爱打什么大逃杀。

lines.en: : That...is actually a quite apt description of what our class has devolved into.
lines.zh: : 这……其实相当贴切地描述了我们班已经沦落成什么样了。

lines.en: scene imaniandgirls16
: Well, then I bet you’re glad you have me!
lines.zh: : 那我猜你很庆幸有我在吧！

lines.en: : Do you intend to dismantle our battle royale, Imani? Or do you intend to {i}win{/i} it?
lines.zh: : 你是打算瓦解我们的大逃杀，Imani？还是打算{i}赢下{/i}它？

lines.en: : I {i}intend{/i} to just talk about a bunch of cool shit and then say I’m not going to participate in the battle royale, but then probably get sucked in anyway because that’s how these kinda things go.
lines.zh: : 我{i}打算{/i}聊一堆很酷的东西，然后说我不会参加大逃杀，但最后大概还是会被卷进去，因为这种事一向如此。

lines.en: : What a roundabout way of admitting we might sleep together one day.
lines.zh: : 绕这么大一圈，其实就是在承认我们哪天可能会上床。

lines.en: scene imaniandgirls17
: Why do {i}you{/i} sound surprised when you basically invited me to a threesome yesterday?
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}昨天基本上都邀请我玩三人行了，为什么听起来还这么惊讶？

lines.en: : Oooooh, I’m suddenly very interested in this conversation.
lines.zh: : 哦—————我对这个话题突然很感兴趣。

lines.en: : Me too.
lines.zh: : 我也是。

lines.en: scene imaniandgirls18
: I heard somebody say threesome so I decided to join the conversation.
lines.zh: : 我听到有人说三人行，所以决定加入对话。

lines.en: : It looks like there are five of us, though, so which two are sitting out?
lines.zh: : 不过看起来我们有五个人，所以哪两个要旁观？

lines.en: : The more the merrier! Fivesome! Fivesome! Fiveso- wait. I shouldn’t be cheering that. {i}The NSA is always listening...{/i}
lines.zh: : 人越多越热闹！五人行！五人行！五人——等等。我不该为此欢呼的。{i}NSA 可一直在听着呢……{/i}

lines.en: : How do you even have a fivesome?! That can’t possibly work!
lines.zh: : 五人行到底怎么搞？！那根本不可能成立吧！

lines.en: : If anyone would know how it would work, I imagine it would be you, dearest Makoto. What with all your wonderful mother has taught you and everything.
lines.zh: : 要说谁最清楚怎么搞得成，我想就是你了，亲爱的 Makoto。毕竟你那位了不起的母亲教过你那么多东西。

lines.en: : Is Makoto’s mom a slut or something?
lines.zh: : Makoto 的妈妈是荡妇之类的吗？

lines.en: scene imaniandgirls19
: Not...exactly?
lines.zh: : 不……完全是？

lines.en: : Well, whatever. I’m ready when you guys are. This party’s kinda beat anyway.
lines.zh: : 算了，无所谓。你们准备好的时候我随时奉陪。反正这场派对也有点无聊了。

lines.en: scene imaniandgirls20
: You do realize you don’t {i}have{/i} to be here...right, Kirin? If you’re not going to associate with anyone, why even come?
lines.zh: : 你明白你其实{i}不必{/i}待在这儿……对吧，Kirin？既然你不打算和任何人交往，那还来干什么？

lines.en: : What are you talking about? I’m associating right now. And I’ll be doing a lot more associating once we take our pants off.
lines.zh: : 你在说什么？我现在就在交往啊。而且等我们把裤子脱了，我会交往得更多。

lines.en: : Damn. This bitch thirsty.
lines.zh: : 靠。这娘们饥渴得很。

lines.en: : I don’t mind Kirin being around, but seeing as we’ve got a little group of intellectuals here, I propose that we make her contribute something of substantial value to prove her worth.
lines.zh: : 我不介意 Kirin 待在这儿，不过既然我们这儿有个小小的知识分子团体，我提议让她贡献点有实质价值的东西，来证明她的价值。

lines.en: scene imaniandgirls18
: This is a really weird start to a fivesome.
lines.zh: : 这五人行的开场可真够怪的。

lines.en: : I agree with Nodoka. If you’re not going to contribute, we’re just going to assume you’re here to flirt with Sensei and-
lines.zh: : 我同意 Nodoka 的说法。如果你不打算贡献，那我们只能认为你是来和老师调情的，然后——

lines.en: : I’m down for a foursome without Sensei if that’s what you mean.
lines.zh: : 如果是这个意思的话，我倒是愿意来个没有老师的四人行。

lines.en: : Rude.
lines.zh: : 无礼。

lines.en: : That’s obviously not what I mean!
lines.zh: : 我显然不是这个意思！

lines.en: scene imaniandgirls21
: What I {i}mean{/i} is that you can’t just hijack an intellectual conversation for the sole purpose of turning it into some orgy invitation!
lines.zh: : 我的{i}意思{/i}是，你不能为了把话题变成某种群交邀请，就硬生生劫持一场知性对话！

lines.en: : What are you talking about? I am literally only here because I heard the word “threesome.”
lines.zh: : 你在说什么？我来这儿的字面原因就是听到了“三人行”这个词。

lines.en: : Okay, fine. That topic was brought up. But before Sensei arrived, this was a fun, bonding experience between three smart people! And I never get to talk to smart people! Let me have this!
lines.zh: : 行吧，好吧。这个话题确实是我提起的。但在老师来之前，这是三个聪明人之间一场有趣又增进感情的活动！而我从来没机会和聪明人说话！让我享受一下吧！

lines.en: scene imaniandgirls22
: What the fuck is that supposed to mean?! I’m smart!
lines.zh: : 你这话他妈的什么意思？！我很聪明！

lines.en: : Are you?
lines.zh: : 是吗？

lines.en: scene imaniandgirls23
: Yes!
: Maybe not Nodoka or Makoto smart, but I’m not a fucking idiot! I’m definitely above average at least!
lines.zh: : 也许没到 Nodoka 或 Makoto 那么聪明，但我不是他妈的白痴！我至少绝对在平均水平以上！

lines.en: : Then...contribute and prove your worth or whatever it is Nodoka suggested.
lines.zh: : 那就……贡献点什么，证明你的价值，或者 Nodoka 说的随便什么。

lines.en: : What the fuck does that even- ugh!
lines.zh: : 那他妈的到底要我—— 呃！

lines.en: scene imaniandgirls24
: Salutations, seasoned intellectuals. May I burden you with my presence in exchange for a tiny little tidbit of information relevant to my current state of being?
lines.zh: : 各位资深知识分子，你们好。能否允许我以一条与我当前状态相关的小小情报为交换，用我的存在叨扰各位？

lines.en: : Because I do believe it may help you all understand me a little better and all I {i}really{/i} want is to get along.
lines.zh: : 因为我相信这能帮你们更好地理解我一点，而我{i}真正{/i}想要的只是好好相处。

lines.en: Kirin leaves out the part about getting naked and fingering everyone, which is what I, a real intellectual, know she actually wants.
lines.zh: Kirin 略过了“把大家都扒光、用手指捅一遍”那部分——而我这个真正的知识分子知道，那才是她真正想要的。

lines.en: : What is this “tidbit” of relevant information, Kirin? Because if it’s something as simple as just feeling left out, that’s hardly new information and changes absolutely nothing.
lines.zh: : 那么，Kirin，这条“情报”是什么？如果只是“觉得被排挤”这么简单，那根本算不上什么新信息，也丝毫改变不了什么。

lines.en: : Mmmmm...that depends. But I yield my time to the girl from dorm ten.
lines.zh: : 嗯嗯嗯……那要看情况。不过我把发言时间让给十号宿舍的那位女孩。

lines.en: scene imaniandgirls25
: Do you know what FOMO stands for, Makoto?
lines.zh: : Makoto，你知道 FOMO 是什么的缩写吗？

lines.en: : The fear of missing out, obviously. But that’s no excuse for-
lines.zh: : 当然是“错失恐惧症”。但那不能成为……

lines.en: : Actually, it {i}is{/i} an excuse.
lines.zh: : 实际上，它{i}能{/i}成为理由。

lines.en: : And while it’s not technically a “new” psychological phenomenon, rapid advancements in technology have been making it significantly more common lately.
lines.zh: : 而且虽然严格来说它不是什么“新”的心理现象，但科技的飞速发展让它近来变得明显更普遍了。

lines.en: : It’s even seeing a substantial increase in presence in medical journals- a thing that, surprise, I read! Because I’m a big, smart girl just like you!
lines.zh: : 它甚至在医学期刊上的出现率大幅上升——而那些期刊，惊喜吧，我是看的！因为我是个又大又聪明的女孩，就跟你一样！

lines.en: : Oh! And did you know that the links between FOMO and more medically accepted conditions like anxiety and depression are gathering more and more support every year?
lines.zh: : 哦！而且你知道吗，FOMO 与焦虑症、抑郁症这类更被医学认可的状况之间的联系，每年都得到越来越多的支持？

lines.en: : Would you tell someone that depression isn’t a good enough reason for their actions, Makoto?
lines.zh: : 你会告诉一个抑郁症患者说，抑郁不足以成为他们行为的理由吗，Makoto？

lines.en: : Or are you just caught up in the equally interesting psychological phenomenon of being a fucking bitch?
lines.zh: : 还是说，你只是陷入了另一个同样有趣的心理学现象——当个彻头彻尾的贱人？

lines.en: scene imaniandgirls26
: Damn, Makoto! You just gonna let her FO your MO like that?!
lines.zh: : 靠，Makoto！你就这么由着她把你的 MO 给 FO 了啊？！

lines.en: : That...
: Depression isn’t...
lines.zh: : 抑郁症不是……

lines.en: scene imaniandgirls27
: Ugh. Fine. You win. I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 呃。行吧。你赢了。对不起。

lines.en: : You can stay and hang out with us. I didn’t mean to ostracize you. And now that I understand you’re psychologically compelled to-
lines.zh: : 你可以留下来和我们一起玩。我不是故意要排挤你。既然现在我明白你是出于心理上的……

lines.en: scene imaniandgirls25
: Thanks but no thanks. I’m gonna go walk around the halls and try to find someone a little less smart to talk to since I’m not good enough for you.
lines.zh: : 谢了，不必。我要去走廊转转，找个没那么聪明的人聊聊天，反正我配不上你。

lines.en: : Oh, come on. I didn’t mean it. I told you I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，别这样。我不是那个意思。我都说了对不起了。

lines.en: scene imaniandgirls28
: Wanna come with me, Sensei? Or are you too good for me now too?
lines.zh: : 要一起吗，老师？还是说你现在也觉得我配不上你了？

lines.en: : You worded that question in a way that makes it very hard for me to refuse without sounding like a complete asshole.
lines.zh: : 你这个问题的措辞方式，让我很难拒绝又不显得像个彻头彻尾的混蛋。

lines.en: : You’re already a complete asshole and have done much worse. But I suck too, so I guess we can just go suck together or something.
lines.zh: : 你本来就是个彻头彻尾的混蛋，还干过更过分的事。不过我也挺烂的，所以我觉得我们可以一起去烂，什么的。

lines.en: I hope that has a double meaning.
lines.zh: 我希望这句话有双层含义。

lines.en: Actually, knowing Kirin, it {i}probably{/i} has a double meaning.
lines.zh: 以 Kirin 的性格来看，它{i}大概{/i}真有双层含义。

lines.en: And so I am left with no other choice but to do this.
lines.zh: 所以我别无选择，只能这么做。

lines.en: : Sure.
: You should apologize to Makoto for calling her a bitch, though.
lines.zh: : 不过你该为叫 Makoto 贱人向她道歉。

lines.en: : No thanks.
lines.zh: : 不用了，谢了。

lines.en: scene imaniandgirls29
: Well, you can’t say I didn’t try.
lines.zh: : 行吧，你不能说我没试过。

lines.en: : That girl’s gonna cause some problems for us, isn’t she?
lines.zh: : 那丫头以后会给我们惹麻烦吧？

lines.en: : No...She’s normally fine in school. I just pushed her a little too far.
lines.zh: : 不会……她在学校里平时挺好的。只是我逼得有点过了。

lines.en: : And, on that note, I need another glass of wine. But when I return...more genomics.
lines.zh: : 话说回来，我得再来一杯葡萄酒。不过等我回来……继续聊基因组学。

lines.en: scene black
Kirin waits for me near the door and the two of us walk out together.
lines.zh: Kirin 在门边等我，然后我们一起走了出去。

lines.en: I can feel the irritation essentially pouring out of her, so I really do hope that wherever the two of us wind up going is somewhere that can kind of...absorb it, I guess.
lines.zh: 我能感觉到她的烦躁几乎是从身上往外溢的，所以我真心希望我们俩最后去的地方能稍微……吸收掉它，大概吧。

lines.en: Or maybe I can just fuck it out of her.
lines.zh: 或者我干脆把它从她身上操出去。

lines.en: That sounds like a better idea.
lines.zh: 这个主意听起来更好。

lines.en: if karinlied == True:
scene imaniandgirls30
scene imaniandgirls31
: Okay! I managed to pry the microphone out of Ami’s hands {i}and{/i} got a second one just for you.
lines.zh: : 好了！我成功把麦克风从 Ami 手里抢了过来，{i}还{/i}特地给你弄了第二支。

lines.en: : I hope you’re good at Spanish, cause-
lines.zh: : 希望你西班牙语不错，因为——

lines.en: : Did you see that just now?
lines.zh: : 你刚才看到了吗？

lines.en: scene imaniandgirls32
: See what? What’s wrong?
lines.zh: : 看到什么？怎么了？

lines.en: : Sensei and...my sister. Walking out together. Where do you think they’re going?
lines.zh: : 老师和……我姐姐。一起走出去了。你觉得他们要去哪儿？

lines.en: if ayanelust15 == False:
: Sensei and Kirin? I don’t know. Maybe they’re just taking a walk or something?
lines.zh: : 老师和 Kirin？我不知道。也许他们只是去散个步什么的？

lines.en: : A walk...
lines.zh: : 散步……

lines.en: : Do you...want to follow them or something? I can just give these back, you know. Despacito is forever, so we can sing whenever we want.
lines.zh: : 你……想跟上去什么的吗？我把这两支还回去就行。Despacito 永远都在，我们什么时候想唱都行。

lines.en: scene imaniandgirls33
: No. I’m probably just being weird. I’m sure it’s nothing.
lines.zh: : 不。我大概只是在犯矫情。我肯定没什么的。

lines.en: : Yeah. I’m definitely weird.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我确实很矫情。

lines.en: scene imaniandgirls34
: Wait...Spanish?
lines.zh: : 等等……西班牙语？

lines.en: else:
scene imaniandgirls35
: Sensei and...Kirin?...
lines.zh: : 老师和……Kirin？……

lines.en: : Yeah...
: They just...left.
lines.zh: : 他们就那么……走了。

lines.en: : They walked right past me...
lines.zh: : 他们从我身边直接走过去了……

lines.en: : Isn’t that kind of weird?...
lines.zh: : 这难道不有点奇怪吗？……

lines.en: scene imaniandgirls36
: Ayane?
lines.zh: : Ayane？

lines.en: : Let’s just...
lines.zh: : 我们还是……

lines.en: : Sing...
lines.zh: : 唱歌吧……
